fields.why: Table 1 chi-square tests run across 5 age groups and 4 race/ethnicity groups (rule 2), and Table 2 gives VE for 3 age groups.
Age and race/ethnicity are the SPD margins with 3 or more groups; sex is a pair and study site is not an SPD.

The Table 1 chi-squares are omnibus tests across 5 age and 4 race groups. The flagged chi-square belongs to those Table 1 entries; VE across the 3 Table 2 age groups has only per-group CIs against 0 and no test across groups, so side by side stands.
